test_cases.name: rules_before_scenes
test_cases.input: Bau die DAME-Regeln in godot/ als erstes Stück.
assertions: Puts transitions in a RefCounted with no Node dependency
Does not create MTG untap or combat phases
Keeps Q at 0 points distinct from the Dame call

test_cases.name: hidden_info_ai
test_cases.input: Schreib die harte KI so dass sie gut blufft.
assertions: AI receives DameView for its own viewer id
Policy function does not accept raw opponent hands

test_cases.name: table_ui_keys
test_cases.input: Mach die Tischszene mit den gleichen Tasten wie die Webversion.
assertions: Maps 1-4 Space Enter D Z E Esc
Does not put score math in the button handler
Keeps GL Compatibility and German labels

test_cases.name: wrong_dame_penalty
test_cases.input: Wenn Dame falsch gerufen wird, muss die nächste Runde eine Strafkarte geben.
assertions: Wrong call appends penalty cards on next deal
